description: 防災マップデータ 防災アセス 震度予測・液状化予測 [fire, police and emergency services and earthquakes] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大津市. 防災アセス（震度予測）は、平成16年度に実施した防災アセスメントで調査した、琵琶湖西岸断層帯において大津市が最も大きな影響を受けると予測される堅田断層北部を破壊開始点とした場合の震度予測を地図上に示したものです。 防災アセス（液状化予測）は、平成16年度に実施した防災アセスメントで調査した、琵琶湖西岸断層帯において大津市が最も大きな影響を... Coverage: 大津市. The portal files it under the publisher 大津市. Its tags are ハザードマップ, 地震, 液状化, 災害, 防災. It offers 3 resource(s) in kml, shape, xlsl. The portal shows 2025-03-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
